title: PSD “Recycle Bin” symbolic action aimed at Vetëvendosje and Albin Kurti
reason: The reported action criticized an electoral rival and its candidate; no demand directed to Kosovo’s government or state policy is established. It is not included as a state-target protest.
notes: CIVICUS reports the action within its 26 Nov 2020–20 Jan 2021 window; search-only local reports identify 19 Jan. The linked Koha article was not opened. Attendance is unknown, and the available account targets an electoral rival/candidate rather than established state policy.

title: Cystic Fibrosis Association protest over medicine shortages
reason: CIVICUS reports a cystic-fibrosis medicine protest within its 26 Nov 2020–20 Jan 2021 overview, but the occurrence date is not specified; the linked KOHA page was not opened. January onset is unestablished, so the lead cannot be assigned to this unit.
notes: The linked KOHA page has a 7 Dec 2020 publication date; do not treat that as the protest date. CIVICUS confirms a distinct protest outside the Ministry of Health but gives no exact occurrence date. No continuity into January was found.

title: Protest outside the University of Pristina’s Christ the Saviour Church
reason: Outside the January unit; the opened dated Government of Serbia compilation places the protest reference on 11 June 2021, not in January.
notes: The phrase appeared in a 2021 annual compilation under June. It was a search false positive for the January church query and is not a January candidate.

title: Gjakova occupational-medicine specialists protest outside the Ministry of Health in Pristina
reason: Outside the January unit; date and report describe a distinct February gathering.
notes: The reported organizer (Gjakova National Center for Occupational Medicine) and grievance (discrimination, unequal pay, transfers) differ from the 25 Jan North Mitrovica march. Do not merge across month, location, organizer or demands. Crowd size remains unknown for the February unit.
